description: Complete guide to Athlone, Westmeath: cost of living, home prices, neighborhoods, remote work readiness, and relocation tips.
content:
Overview

Athlone is a city in Westmeath with a population of 22,000. The heart of Ireland, a historic town on the River Shannon with a magnificent castle, a vibrant marina, and a strategic location at the crossroads of Ireland. Housing costs are close to the national average. The overall cost of living is below the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 6a growing zone supports Cool to mild — apples, pears, berries, many vegetables. Sunshine is limited, with about 145 sunny days a year. Reported crime rates are relatively low.
